title: OneNote: Copilot Notebooks suggest artifacts to create
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap and Microsoft's tenant notice support its rollout, default state and feature description. The documented controls and licensing statements are accurate, and the page distinguishes broader notebook policies from the undocumented switch for artifact suggestions.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors applies a desired-state baseline when mode is applyOnce.
claims.quote: applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode. POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors

claims.claim: The Graph request's mode property can be set to applyOnce.
claims.quote: mode | monitorMode | The monitor mode. The possible values are: monitorOnly, applyOnce, unknownFutureValue.

claims.claim: baseline.resources[].properties.value for microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks can be set to the string 0 to disable the setting.
claims.quote: 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting. "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks", "resourceVersion": 1, "properties": { "value": "1" }

claims.claim: baseline.resources[].properties.value for microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks can be set to the string 1 to enable the setting.

claims.claim: The Graph Tenant Configuration Management route is a preview API.
claims.quote: This article lists the Copilot resource types supported in preview for monitoring and snapshots through the Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) APIs in Microsoft Graph beta.

claims.claim: TCM supports these Cloud Policy settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: The Graph route fails when the target setting is configured in a group-level policy.
claims.quote: ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: Licences are assigned in the Microsoft 365 admin center under Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph PowerShell assigns a user's licence with Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @().

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least the License Administrator or User Administrator role.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.
